1226855.abstract: Jamie reacts to the AWS re:Invent 2017 keynote, commenting on announcements including ECS for Kubernetes, EC2 Bare Metal Instances, multi-master Aurora, Neptune, S3 Select, SageMaker, DeepLens, and Transcribe, plus critiques the keynote's "house band" segment and nearly three-hour length.

1229898.abstract: Jamie attends The New Standards holiday show, spotting former Vice President Mondale in the audience and watching Trip Shakespeare perform. Photos show the stage lit in purple and white before a full theater crowd, plus links to other years' New Standards holiday show recaps.

1229899.abstract: Jamie shares photos and impressions from a return visit to Holidazzle in Loring Park after years away, noting it was once a parade, and describes crowds under lit trees, a choir performance, and winter fireworks.

1230047.abstract: Jamie describes pacing during a Zoom call while also on a cell call, muted but with video on, which a team member turned into a Zoom video background. Jamie finds it especially funny when several colleagues used the pacing loop as their background simultaneously.

1230437.abstract: Jamie shares photos and impressions from The New Standards Holiday Show, praising the first half featuring Okee Dokee Brothers, The Owls, Chris Koza, Jeremy Messersmith, Matt Wilson, Dessa, Tina Schleske, and Caroline Steele, plus a closing performance of "Snow Days."

1230440.abstract: Jamie expresses excitement about attending The New Standards holiday show, noting Mrs. Braintree is also there, and links to other New Standards Holiday Show posts from 2013, 2018, 2019, 2021, and 2023.

1230476.abstract: Jamie describes a pandemic-era date night with wife Tammy: getting takeout from Lake & Irving, then parking by Lake Bde Maka Ska to watch "Hunt for the Wilderpeople" on Netflix using the Tesla's touchscreen. Jamie notes the immersive surround sound and that running heat and entertainment used about 10% battery.

123060.abstract: Jamie tries the new micro.blog iOS app and praises how Manton Reece handles subject lines, noting titles appear once a post's body reaches a certain length. Jamie still prefers keeping a main blog separate from microblog fragments but likes seeing the format evolve.

1231670.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a Minnesota Wild versus Montreal Canadiens game at Xcel Energy Center, attending with Amy Patton, Ian Redlin and Paul Birkbeck, documenting a 2-0 lead that becomes a 7-1 Wild win.

1231673.abstract: Jamie's wife Tammy acquires a custom Einstein cabinet made by artist Paul Carbo, which Jamie calls the coolest piece of furniture in the house. Photos show the life-size carved and painted cabinet, its caricature bust, and its open interior shelves.

1232315.abstract: Jamie describes watching Brandi Carlile's livestream "Still Home for the Holidays," praising the Christmas song renditions, including O Holy Night and The River, and notes occasional swear words worth flagging for family viewing. Jamie links to a list of Brandi Carlile shows.

1232319.abstract: Jamie cooks the Lamb Ragu over Parisian Gnocchi from Travail Kitchen's Family Meal series, finding the dish tasty, and links to the accompanying Vimeo video Jamie enjoys watching even without making the recipe.

1232334.abstract: Jamie describes completing a fourth consecutive day of workouts on a Peloton bike, noting increased stamina and a feeling of "dancing on the pedals" when standing to climb. Jamie mentions growing confidence about riding a Century next summer for the first time in over a decade, tagging the post #FitByFifty.

1234338.abstract: Jamie shares a shout out from CJ Chilvers, who calls The Weekly Thing "the Ted Lasso of newsletters" in a Mailchimp newsletter, citing a Tesla date night idea. Jamie calls the praise "super high" and plans to frame it.

1234412.abstract: Jamie adds commenting and reaction features to the Link Blog using Hyvor Talk, citing its clean interface, simple reactions, and privacy focus without hidden ads. Jamie previously tried Commento but found it lacking advanced features.

1234760.abstract: Jamie marks 14 years on Twitter, joining Dec 20, 2006 as user #82,903 before the SXSW unveiling, and notes using TweetDeleter to purge tweets after 60 days while keeping archives via Pinboard's Twitter archiving since 2008.

1234909.abstract: Jamie marks the Winter Solstice, noting Minneapolis gets only 527 minutes of daylight with sunrise at 7:48 am and sunset at 4:35 pm. Jamie enjoys Minnesota's cold and snow but dislikes the darkness, and proposes making the solstice a bigger family event, involving the kids, to mark the shortest day and the return of longer daylight ahead.

1241208.abstract: Jamie attends a New Standards show at The Dakota, ordering a Blue Monk Lemonade and later a Love Supreme, while waiting for Phoebe and Dave-O to arrive. Jamie shares a photo of Phoebe after the show and links to a list of New Standards shows.

1241578.abstract: Jamie shares photos from Preener's Eve 2015, a New Year event with The New Standards at the Dakota, noting front row seats and linking to a list of The New Standards shows Jamie has attended.

1241579.abstract: Jamie attends The New Standards' "Preeners Eve" show at the Dakota, noting the walk over from the parking ramp with Chan Poling, and shares a photo of the trio performing onstage. Jamie links to a running list of The New Standards shows attended.

1241580.abstract: Jamie shares a note about attending The New Standards' "Preeners" show at Dakota Jazz Club & Restaurant with many friends, and links to a list of The New Standards shows on thingelstad.com.

1241581.abstract: Jamie attends a New Standards show at The Dakota with Tammy, Phoebe, and Dave-O, praising the band's cover of "Androgynous" and noting the difficulty of not singing along to "Snow Day." Jamie links to a list of New Standards shows attended.

1243550.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a Kitchen Window baking class, showing caramel pecan rolls glazed with sticky sauce and topped with pecans, plus Jamie's wife Tammy preparing donut dough at a flour-dusted counter.

1243657.abstract: Jamie's newsletter, Weekly Thing, reaches a soft goal of 1,000 subscribers, and Jamie shares a congratulatory email notification from Buttondown, the newsletter platform used to send it.

1245136.abstract: Jamie shares a Tech.MN "CTO Spotlight" conversation with Jac Stark and Nels Pederson, recorded in August 2020 but published in December, covering a wide range of topics; the episode is sponsored by Livefront and embedded via YouTube.

1246039.abstract: Jamie reports a new 60-minute Peloton power record of 676 kJ, up from a previous 653 kJ set on September 26, 2020, achieved in Matt Wilpers's Power Zone Endurance Ride. Jamie notes spending significant time in Zone 4 and at heart-rate Threshold, plans an updated FTP test, and credits Peloton Live Rides with friends for pushing effort.

1246547.abstract: Jamie describes starting a weekly Family Screen Time Review with the family, sharing iPhone Screen Time data and pickups, then each person highlighting a personal insight without judging others.

1253915.abstract: Jamie attends the 2021 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Holiday Breakfast, a virtual event titled "Our Rising Voices: A Call for Bold Social Action," noting it marks the 31st year, with General Mills' leadership and UNCF's work highlighted.

1254820.abstract: Jamie describes rewriting the description for the Weekly Thing newsletter, using Josh Spector's Five-Day Plan to Grow Your Newsletter as a framework.

1254887.abstract: Jamie reflects on backing Indie Microblogging on Kickstarter four years earlier and praises how micro.blog has evolved into a favorite blogging platform, having consolidated over 15 years of blogging and thousands of posts onto it, and recommends it as a home on the web.

1254897.abstract: Jamie contrasts quick top replies, used for most email especially on mobile, with inline replies now used for longer messages to friends and family. Jamie finds inline replies encourage more thoughtful writing and suggests trying them with formatting and trimming.

1261124.abstract: Jamie describes a visit to Pair Cupworks, enjoying a cappuccino and Costa Rica pour over, then buying Guatemalan coffee from La Galera Farm and Ethiopian coffee from the Mijane Family. Jamie chats with owners Kimhak En and Eugenia Tai about coffee shops, techniques, and starting their business.

1262409.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a Minnesota Wild versus Colorado Avalanche hockey game at Xcel Energy Center, including action shots from the tied first period and a family selfie taken in the stands.

1262579.abstract: Jamie visits Coon Bluff Recreation Area to see the Salt River wild horses, cared for by the non-profit Salt River Wild Horse Management group, which puts out hay daily and allows visitors to walk among the horses if slow and calm. Jamie photographs the horses with a long lens after watching a group of twenty skirmish.

1264381.abstract: Jamie describes a visit to Saguaro National Park, ending up at the East park by accident and completing a short second hike of the day. Jamie notes the trails look extensive and the loop road draws many cyclists, with photos showing saguaro cacti, desert scenery, and horseback riders.

1264383.abstract: Jamie describes a day trip to Tucson's Sabino Canyon Recreation Area, taking the shuttle to the top of the trail and walking down, stopping at several spots along the way. Jamie notes crossing a cold spring creek barefoot and shares photos from the visit.

1264386.abstract: Jamie describes a visit to Boyce Thompson Arboretum, walking the main loop and then hiking the upper trail on the hillside. Jamie shares photos of saguaro cacti, rocky canyon cliffs, barrel cacti, eucalyptus trees, mesquite trees, and kids exploring the rock formations.

1264595.abstract: Jamie attends Minnedemo, sharing photos and impressions of presenters including Anna Klombies, Jim Bernard, PCs for People, SportNgin's Carson Kipfer, Kidizen, Double Robotics and CartStack, and thanks the event's volunteers.

1264598.abstract: Jamie shares notes from Minnebar 10, covering sessions on sleep improvement with Dan Grigsby, polyglot persistence, encrypting personal communication with Colin Bartol, and smart watches with Mike Bollinger, plus giving a 17th Minnebar talk about Minnebar itself.

1267462.abstract: Jamie visits the Noah Purifoy Outdoor Museum in Joshua Tree, unfamiliar with Purifoy beforehand, and finds the artist's background impressive and the museum unique and a little confusing. Jamie shares photos taken while walking through, having chosen to view the art before reading about Purifoy.

1267467.abstract: Jamie describes an early morning hike up Ryan Mountain in Joshua Tree National Park, a nonstop 1,000-foot ascent. Underdressed in shorts while others wore winter gear, Jamie finds the strenuous climb a great accomplishment at the summit.

1267489.abstract: Jamie describes hiking Skull Rock Trail after visiting Ryan Mountain Trail and Skull Rock, sharing a GPS route map of the rocky desert path and photos of kids climbing the rocks while Jamie watches anxiously.

1269014.abstract: Jamie outlines an approach to crypto investing: a 3+ year horizon, limiting consideration to coins with a $10B+ market cap tradeable on Coinbase (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Chainlink, Bitcoin Cash, Stellar Lumens, plus stablecoin USDC as an exception), and developing a distinct investment thesis for each.

1269191.abstract: Jamie's wife Tammy calls Wind Cave Trail perhaps a favorite hike ever after a morning hike with Jamie and dog Lucky, a 1.7-mile, 800-foot climb taking under an hour. Jamie notes fantastic views, varied terrain, and recommends going early since the trail gets busy.

1269534.abstract: Jamie describes a family hike at Cave Creek Regional Park, looping via Go John Trail, Quartz Trail, and Slate Trail for 3.5 miles with 425 feet of gain in 1h 22m. Jamie notes an accidental extra mile from missing a "North" trail sign, saguaro cacti and quartz outcroppings along the way, and dog Lucky getting dusty and tired.

1272522.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a Timberwolves versus Kings game, including courtside shots of Timberwolves warmups, a blue-lit pregame arena display with an Okogie jersey on the jumbotron, and the opening jump ball at Target Center.

1274104.abstract: Jamie attends the MHTA Tech Talent event, hearing Target CIO Mike McNamara open the session and data presented by Deb Broberg of RealTime Talent, Allison Liuzzi of Minnesota Compass, and Matt Lewis of Make It. MSP on diversity and workforce trends.

1274500.abstract: Jamie shares photos and updates from SPS Commerce's #TeamSPS Tech Summit 2019, held despite -20F temperatures, covering sessions from Jim Frome, Dan Juckniess, and Karin Lucas, plus topics like security, career paths, cloud database "Worry-as-a-Service," and service team wins, followed by networking and a Trivia Mafia event.

1275385.abstract: Jamie attends the MHTA Tech Talent 2020 event, noting workforce data presented by Grant Riewe, Erin Olson, Sri Koneru, and Tim Welsh, and shares photos of speakers and attendees. Jamie also presents success stories about attracting, retaining, and developing technology talent at SPS Commerce.

1275988.abstract: Jamie shares photos and updates from a Minnesota Wild versus Nashville Predators game at Xcel Energy Center, including Lindsey Vonn dropping the ceremonial first puck and Tyler catching a game puck. The game goes to 3-3 overtime and a shootout, though Jamie notes the Wild did not win.

1278175.abstract: Jamie's family tries Trdelník, Czech chimney cakes, for the first time at Arizona Chimney Cakes. Tammy's wife orders the Berliner while the rest get the Nutella-filled Nana; Jamie notes everyone liked them but thinks the traditional version might be easier to eat next time.

1278188.abstract: Jamie describes visiting Lost Dutchman State Park and hiking the Treasure Loop Trail, a 2.5-mile route with 480 feet of elevation gain in 80°F sun, noting the legend of a lost mine in the Superstition Mountains. Jamie shares a GPS route map and photos of the scenic landscape.

1278212.abstract: Jamie describes hiking the Broken Arrow Trail in Sedona, initially wary of reported Pink Jeep Tours traffic but finding vehicles stop early on the route. The hike covers 1.4 miles out and back with little elevation change, cut short by time, with plans to continue to Chicken Point on a future visit.

1278217.abstract: Jamie recounts a weekend trip from Flagstaff, AZ to the Grand Canyon during a family getaway with Tammy, Tyler, and Mazie, marking Tyler's first visit and Mazie's first memorable one. The group toured the South Rim, walked the Trail of Time, and Jamie shares plans to return with a permit to camp at the canyon bottom.

1278507.abstract: Jamie describes a visit to the Music Instrument Museum (mim.org) in Arizona, praising the wide range of instruments and artist displays, including a Johnny Cash exhibit and a Ukrainian folk section, plus wireless headphones that play sound automatically near each display.

1278510.abstract: Jamie visits the Desert Botanical Garden and shares photos of dense cactus fields, red-spined barrel cacti, saguaro and cholla clusters, and rare Cardon and Crested Saguaro cacti, plus Chihuly glass sculptures displayed among the desert plants.

1280060.abstract: Jamie and Tammy have lunch at Chelsea's Kitchen, recommended by Jamie's brother Isaiah and wife Tiffany, enjoying Prickly Pear Margaritas, New Mexico Hatch Chili Queso, Green Chile Cornbread, and LGO Reserve Short Rib Tacos.

1280228.abstract: Jamie and Jamie's wife Tammy hike the Infinity Loop trail in Dreamy Draw near Piestewa Peak in Phoenix, a 5-mile loop with 500 feet of elevation whose GPS track forms a figure-eight. Jamie notes the trail has no markers and many intersecting paths, making the AllTrails app necessary to avoid getting lost.

1281525.abstract: Jamie announces the first "Techies Who Peloton" ride, organized through Minnestar, scheduled for St. Patrick's Day at 5:30pm as a 30-minute EDM ride with Jess King, using Peloton's newly launched scheduled session feature. Jamie invites Peloton cyclists to join and add the Minnestar tag to their profile.

1281768.abstract: Jamie describes hiking Camelback Mountain in Arizona via the Echo Canyon Trail, calling it the hardest hike attempted, more scramble than hike. The ascent with Tammy took 73 minutes covering 1,317 feet over 1.37 miles, with a 68-minute descent including a fall detected accurately by an Apple Watch.

1281769.abstract: On the final day of a trip to Arizona, Jamie's family tries the Evil Robots escape room at the Nemesis Club, found through Tammy's research. Jamie praises the immersive design, electronics and creative puzzles, noting the room was solved with 31 seconds to spare, making it room 34 on Jamie's escape room list.

1281772.abstract: Jamie describes a final dinner in Phoenix at Vecina, sharing a tasting menu that includes the SalsaTrio, Karaage, Shaved Brussel salad, Mesquite Grilled Cauliflower, Skirt Steak Tacos, Carnitas Empanada, Tylauda, and the restaurant's famous Banana Bread, finding the food flavorful and the portions larger than expected.

1281774.abstract: Jamie describes renting a Kawasaki Teryx4 UTV from American Powersport Rentals, arranged through Duke, for a half-day trail ride at the Rolls OHV Area in Tonto National Forest. Jamie's wife Tammy and family join, with stops at Pobrecito staging area, Palo Fierro, and trail 1863, navigating varied terrain from fast stretches to rocky sections.

1281775.abstract: Jamie recounts stopping for lunch at Silver King Smokehouse in Superior during a drive, praising the brisket as phenomenal and noting the outdoor seating area with picnic tables. Jamie recommends the barbecue to anyone visiting the area.

1281778.abstract: Jamie describes hiking Pinnacle Peak in Scottsdale, Arizona with Tammy, a trail Tammy's Mom and Mazie usually join on Wednesdays. The 2-mile route to marker 101 gains 436 feet, while the return climbs 732 feet; photos show saguaro cacti, granite boulders, golf courses and desert homes along the way.

1283792.abstract: Jamie describes reading "The Boy Who Would Be King" by Ryan Holiday, illustrated by Victor Juhasz, together with Tyler, finding the book, story, points and illustrations well done.

1286900.abstract: Jamie attends a first AFL match at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, watching Richmond defeat Carlton 14-13-97 to 9-10-64. Jamie shares photos of the packed floodlit stadium, the game in progress, scoreboard updates, and the MCG exterior lit at night, describing a growing enthusiasm for the sport.

1289496.abstract: Jamie compares the Ever Given container ship stuck in the Suez Canal to a technologist's queue problem, linking to a real-time vessel map showing dozens of backed-up ships. Jamie notes the canal normally passes 50 ships daily and expects delays before traffic normalizes, pointing to BBC photos illustrating the situation.

1290636.abstract: Jamie describes buying a new sit-stand desk and chair from Podany's, calling it a big upgrade from the previous home office setup described in an October 2020 post. A photo shows a white sit-stand desk with monitor and laptop stand alongside a blue mesh chair.

1290637.abstract: Jamie describes ongoing damage from a Pileated Woodpecker visiting the house each morning between 7-9am, pecking large holes in the gable's untreated lumber siding. Jamie plans to install a metal plate and Hardie Board, and compares the effort to chase it off to Bill Murray battling the gopher in Caddyshack.

1291195.abstract: Jamie watches Enola Holmes on Netflix and enjoys the witty story and characters, praising Millie Bobby Brown's performance in the lead role.

1292547.abstract: Jamie describes watching a livestream of The Cactus Blossoms performing to a limited 50-table audience at First Avenue, praising the multi-camera production and hoping the venue continues offering streaming options for shows.

1292923.abstract: Jamie describes watching Brandi Carlile's first live streamed show from the Ryman Auditorium in Nashville, opening with a solo cover of "Hallelujah" and closing with "Amazing Grace." Jamie calls the band's energy and Carlile's performance amazing and links to a list of Brandi Carlile shows.

1296393.abstract: Jamie describes waiting over two hours in line at Franklin BBQ in Austin, Texas, then trying the brisket, ribs, pulled pork, sausage, and a turkey special, calling the brisket the best ever tasted. Photos show the restaurant sign and a loaded food tray.

1296395.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a visit to Sump Coffee, praising the macchiato, straight espresso and pour over, and noting the shop's Slayer espresso machine. Photos show the storefront sign, a latte with tulip art, and the red Slayer machine on the counter.

1297795.abstract: Jamie shares brief updates and photos from Minnebar 8, covering sessions on advanced MongoDB, Hadoop and big data, free content with Marc Grabanski, and Ian Dees's Obama Tech talk, plus a crowd photo.

1299336.abstract: Jamie describes registering thingelstad.eth on the Ethereum Name Service (ENS), comparing it to DNS and detailing the process using the Rainbow wallet: buying the domain, setting a resolver, adding crypto addresses (Ethereum, Bitcoin, Litecoin, Cardano, Filecoin), and creating a reverse record.

1303317.abstract: Jamie shares notes and photos from Minnebar 9, mentioning sessions by David Hussman, Peter Edstrom on LaTeX, and Andrew Korf on UX design, plus seeing Nick Sieger for the first time since Minnebar 1 and remembering the late Farhan Muhammad.

1304028.abstract: Jamie attends the Minnesota United home opener against NYCFC at Allianz Field with family, describing halftime grass watering, a VAR review, and a 3-3 final score after the match had reached 3-2 at halftime.

1305045.abstract: Jamie shares the arrival of "Think Again: The Power of Knowing What You Don't Know" by Adam Grant, discovered through Three Star Leadership and Tools & Toys reviews describing it as being about the learning culture between your ears.

1305085.abstract: Jamie shares photos and notes from the 2019 Minnesota Aspirations in Computing Awards, including a keynote by Mayo Clinic's Amy Alexander, and highlights #TeamSPS celebrating four SPS Commerce summer interns among the honorees. Links to similar posts from other years are included.

1305090.abstract: Jamie describes attending the 2021 Minnesota Aspirations in Computing Award Ceremony, recognizing young women in STEM, and welcomes four summer interns—Ezigbo, Caroline, Claire, and Cecelia—joining SPS Commerce. Jamie thanks emcee Jade Denson of MnTech for the event's energy.

1306182.abstract: Jamie shares an embedded tweet from Brad Fitzpatrick showing emoji used to indicate vaccine status, and links to an earlier post, "Cocktail Emoji Triples," as related content.

1307266.abstract: Jamie updates a personal cryptocurrency allocation shared previously in March 2021, noting increased Ethereum and Cardano holdings, a doubled Filecoin position, and new additions of Curve DAO and Enjin, with Bitcoin and Ethereum together making up 80% of the portfolio.

1308590.abstract: Jamie describes watching, with the whole family, the guilty verdict on all three charges against Derek Chauvin in the murder of George Floyd, calling it an important but incomplete step in the community's reckoning with racism.

1308847.abstract: Jamie shares photos and brief updates from attending a Mumford & Sons concert, noting bad seats but enjoying the show, and mentions the pre-show music paying tribute to Prince, including "Purple Rain."

1308849.abstract: Jamie shares photos from the MHTA Spring Event 2016, featuring presentations by Minnesota State Demographer Susan Brower on workforce trends, Alexandra Deschamps-Sonsino on the IoT landscape, and Mike Bollinger of Livefront on the evolution of mobile.

1310093.abstract: Jamie shares photos and notes from Minnebar 11, sponsored by SPS Commerce, including sessions by Peter Edstrom on LaTeX and R, Nick Roseth on the DocuMNtary tech history project, and Mike Navarro on recommenders featuring University of Minnesota's GroupLens lab.

1310452.abstract: Jamie shops at Victual, a specialty gift shop in Crosby, MN featuring locally sourced products, and praises the owners' passion and quality experience, calling it a required stop for anyone in the area. Photos show ceramics, artisan cheeses, Minnesota-themed shirts, and soaps.

1310842.abstract: Jamie describes riding the Galloping Goose trail around Huntington Mine lake at Cuyuna Lakes MTB, recommended by the crew at Red Raven bike shop. Jamie, Tammy, and kids Mazie and Tyler cover 12 miles, over half on single track, and plan to return.

1311519.abstract: Jamie describes creating a custom "50" birthday puzzle for Tammy, continuing a tradition of custom Christmas puzzles for the family. Mazie and Tyler hand-drew the design, which Jamie helped digitize and color in Procreate on an iPad Pro, though a printer margin error trimmed part of the seascape artwork.

1312546.abstract: Jamie shares photos and updates from a Minnesota United v Houston Dynamo match at TCF Bank Stadium, including a family halftime selfie, a video review moment, and reactions to the game ending in a 2-1 win for Minnesota United.

1312653.abstract: Jamie and Tammy visit Sooki & Mimi for the first time and try the Prix Fixe Menu, "A Celebration Of Spring Flavors And Nixtamal." Jamie praises the dining room atmosphere, knowledgeable wait staff, and describes courses including aguachile verde, mackerel gravlax tostada, walleye tacos, kimchi mandu, and a hibiscus rhubarb dessert bar.

1312658.abstract: Jamie marks four years using micro.blog, calling it the favorite blogging platform after 17 years that also included .Text, WordPress, SquareSpace, Pelican, and Jekyll. Jamie credits features like Hugo's speed, simple pages, curated collections instead of tags, and 2,039 posts published, thanking Manton and Jean for the service.

1316384.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a Minnesota United v Seattle Sounders match at Allianz Field, including a packed stadium during pre-match ceremonies and players clustered near the goal moments before Minnesota United scores to lead 1-0.

1316632.abstract: Jamie audits App Store subscriptions, finding 16 annual subscriptions totaling $309.06, including 1Blocker, Day One, Drafts, Overcast, and Tweetbot, plus five monthly subscriptions like Disney+, HBO Max, and Apple One totaling $954.60 a year, for a combined $1,263.66 annually. Jamie cancels a few but keeps the rest, noting each provides value.

1316641.abstract: Jamie notes that Elon Musk and Larry Ellison account for over half of all divorces among the ten richest men, calling the pattern predictable, and links to an embedded tweet from StockJabber illustrating the statistic.

1317840.abstract: Jamie recounts introducing Ben and Luke to open MinneBar 6, an event drawing about 1,000 attendees, calling it the best MinneBar yet. Jamie shares a panoramic photo from the stage and links to a Unix tools resource and further Minnebar photos and collections.

1318870.abstract: Jamie shares photos and highlights from SPS TechJam 2019, a #TeamSPS community event with presenters from Minneapolis, Kyiv, Toronto, and New Jersey. Jamie thanks organizer Ken Korth, notes Thad's tech support, and praises the keynote from Chris Williams of Badass Agile.

1320679.abstract: Jamie shares photos and notes from the #TeamSPS TechJam 2017 community event, covering talks by Nate and Dan on serverless solutions, Marcell on Microsoft SQL Server, Valentin (Kyiv office) on microservices migration, Cody on Go, Travis Gosselin on DevOps in the Toronto office, and Dan on isolation benefits, plus a remote keynote from Jez Humble…

1320810.abstract: Jamie shares notes from three Minnebar 3 sessions: Intro to iPhone Development, Dan Grigsby's "Screw You, LAMP" presentation on virtualization, and WordPress as a CMS, with a link to Jamie's broader Minnebar collection.

1320915.abstract: Jamie shares photos and notes from Minnebar 5, describing record attendance, a full JavaScript session, a GPU-accelerated iPad development talk, and an Intro to Git session, and links to a Minnebar photo collection.

1321904.abstract: Jamie shares photos and updates from a Minnesota United FC match against the San Jose Quakes at TCF Bank Stadium, including a Ramirez goal tying the game 1-1, but San Jose wins and Jamie blames the referees ("Yellow Team").

1322522.abstract: Jamie observes that Elon Musk's May 12 tweet halting Tesla's Bitcoin acceptance over carbon concerns triggered a 10% Bitcoin drop, then notes Filecoin and Cardano fell similarly despite unrelated fundamentals, comparing crypto markets to kids soccer's undisciplined ball-chasing.

1322893.abstract: Jamie describes plans to teach daughter Mazie to drive using the Honda Pilot rather than the Tesla Model 3, since the electric car's power delivery differs too much from a gas engine for a beginner.

1322897.abstract: Jamie marks four years of the Weekly Thing newsletter, launched May 13, 2017, and shares lessons learned: the value of a consistent structure, the surprising difficulty of writing intros, winter photo challenges, deeper reader connections through email, and heavy reliance on automation.

1323580.abstract: Jamie recounts the SPS TechJam 2018 event, an internal SPS Commerce technology conference in Minneapolis with over two dozen presenters covering topics like automation, GraphQL, Kubernetes, Kotlin, Snowflake and evolutionary architecture.

1323806.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a Twins versus Oakland A's game at Target Field in Minneapolis, including a three-run homer and Simmons hitting a two-run homer to tie the game 6-6. Photos also show a Kramarczuk's Polish sausage with kraut and Jamie with Tammy enjoying the sunny afternoon.

1323814.abstract: Jamie describes a Flooded Forest Kayak Tour near Wabasha with Broken Paddle Guiding, joined by brother Isaiah's visiting family. Jamie paddles a Solara 145T Tandem kayak with Tyler, praises the outfitter's stability and guide coverage, and shares photos of the group, a bald eagle, and snakes spotted in the water.

1325107.abstract: Jamie recounts wearing Ecco dress shoes to an in-person gathering with board members, only to discover the soles disintegrating into debris on the patio floor throughout the evening. Jamie shares photos of the crumbling soles and links to an earlier wardrobe mishap, "Finding Pants in Manhattan."

1326870.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a White Sox versus Texas Rangers game at Guaranteed Rate Field, including views of the diamond, a hot dog at lunch, and the scoreboard after the White Sox win 3-0.

1343530.abstract: Jamie recounts the end of an 848 day meditation streak, tracked in the Streaks app, that Jamie had planned to deliberately break at 1,000 days. Instead it ended naturally when Jamie forgot during a packed family pool party for Mazie's upcoming birthday, which Jamie calls the best way for it to end.

1344449.abstract: Jamie compiles crypto-related links originally shared by Balaji Srinivasan in a tweet, including resources like Mastering Bitcoin, Mastering Ethereum, a16z's crypto materials, CryptoZombies, and various blockchain explorers, adding Gas Now, Filecoin Explorer, and Bitclout for reference.

1349707.abstract: Jamie describes REM5 for Good's digital art event, Simulacra Two, which offered NFTs of items from the show. Jamie missed the event but purchases four NFTs, setting up XTZ via Coinbase and a wallet on Kukai to acquire them through the Tezos-based marketplace H=N.

1349710.abstract: Jamie recalls a story shared by Larry Kramer, CEO of MarketWatch, about a sports betting scheme: splitting a group in half, predicting opposite outcomes each round, and only continuing to message those who received correct picks, making the forecaster appear infallible to survivors.

1349716.abstract: Jamie shares an updated crypto portfolio allocation for June 2021, noting a market-wide drawdown citing an NYDIG report ranking bitcoin's decline as its fifth most severe.

1351583.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a Minnesota United FC v FC Dallas match, including crowd shots and a family selfie in 94°F heat, notes United struggled to score, and mentions listening to Wonderwall afterward for consolation.

1357038.abstract: Jamie shares photos and updates from the first day of the Winnipeg Folk Festival main stage, featuring The Small Glories, Brandi Carlile (the highlight), and The Shins, plus camping at Birds Hill Provincial Park.

1357039.abstract: Jamie shares photos and impressions from Day 2 of the Winnipeg Folk Festival, including crowds seeking shade at the Bur Oak stage, Esmé Patterson opening the main stage, Richard Inman's tweener set, Bruce Cockburn, and Camper Van Beethoven at the Big Blue @ Night stage.

1357040.abstract: Jamie shares photos and moments from day three of the Winnipeg Folk Festival, highlighting Peter Yarrow of Peter, Paul and Mary leading kids in "Puff, the Magic Dragon" and the crowd in "Blowin' in the Wind," plus scenes from the kids area and Richard Inman's set on Little Stage in the Woods.

1358799.abstract: Jamie shares photos from the US National Kubb Championship, hosted by usakubb.org, showing a sunny outdoor tournament with dozens of players across multiple grass courts. Jamie's team, Kubbchucks, wins its round robin games 3-0 before being knocked out.

1370481.abstract: Jamie attends day two of DevOpsDays MSP 2014, sponsored by Jamie's organization, following a talk by Jeff Sussna on the differing objectives of development and operations teams.

1372738.abstract: Jamie describes discovering The Zen of Python after seeing it displayed as a Zoom background by André Burgaud, then shares the text of Tim Peters's principles, retrieved by running "python3 -c \"import this\"" in a terminal.

1372747.abstract: Jamie shares photos and live updates from a Minnesota United match against LAFC at TCF Bank Stadium, tracking goals from Ibarra and Ramirez as the score reaches 5-1, plus a family photo where Tyler roots for LAFC.

1373076.abstract: Jamie attends the International Champions Cup match between FC Bayern München and AC Milan with Tyler and family, sharing photos from the stands. Jamie notes FCB leads Milan 1-0 at halftime.

1373077.abstract: Jamie shares updates from attending a U2 concert at TCF Stadium, including a tip to bring a Ziploc bag for phone protection, a pre-show mojito at Cafe Maude, seat location details, and a photo of the stadium's large stage structure.

1373592.abstract: After hail damage totals the Honda Pilot, Jamie's wife Tammy researches replacements, ruling out a long-wait Kia Telluride and an unchanged BMW X5, and finds a Mazda CX-9 Carbon Edition at Morrie's Mazda, which Jamie buys, noting cooled front seats and first-time Apple CarPlay.

1373593.abstract: Jamie previews a two-week summer road trip from Minneapolis to Vermont and back, with stops in Cleveland, OH, Accord, NY, Shaftsbury and St. Johnsbury, VT, Rochester, NY, and Saugatuck, MI, driven in a new Mazda CX-9, covering 2,940 miles and 46 hours of driving.

1377358.abstract: Jamie logs a timestamped drive from Minnesota through Wisconsin, Illinois, Indiana, and Ohio, departing at 5:59am and arriving in Cleveland by 7:40pm, then having dinner at 3 Palms and Graeter's ice cream, part of a multi-day Vermont road trip series.

1377616.abstract: Jamie logs day two of a Vermont road trip, driving from Cleveland through Pennsylvania and New York, stopping for lunch at Four Ways Pub & Eatery in Bellefonte and dinner at Westwind Orchard in Accord, NY, where the Mazda CX-9 passes 1,000 miles.

1378085.abstract: Jamie logs day three of a Vermont road trip: breakfast at Kerhonkson Diner, a drive to Bethel to visit the Woodstock Museum at Bethel Woods Center for the Arts, a Road Sign Math sighting near Wurtsboro, and dinner at The Egg's Nest in High Falls.

1378087.abstract: Jamie highlights NFT market activity cited from the Modern Finance newsletter, including Art Blocks' surge driven by Tyler Hobbs' Fidenza project, CryptoPunk zombie and ape sales including one by Gary Vee, and Jamie's own purchase of a 1/1 XCOPY piece. Jamie notes potential for NFTs beyond collectibles.

1378098.abstract: Jamie describes Dune as a favorite sci-fi world, having read all six Frank Herbert novels in one summer, watched Lynch's 1984 film adaptation many times on Laserdisc, and seen the 2000 Sci-Fi channel mini-series. Jamie shares a trailer and expresses eagerness for the new 2021 movie.

1378794.abstract: Jamie describes a 16.2 mile round-trip bike ride on the Wallkill Valley Rail Trail with bikes rented from New Paltz Biking, highlighting views from the Trellis Bridge 160 feet above the Hudson River and a turnaround at the Ice Caves. Photos show the trail, bridges, cave entrance, river views, and a GPS route map.

1378798.abstract: Jamie describes a tour of Historic Huguenot Street in New Paltz, New York, covering the Calvinist settlement's founding 12 houses, a native wigwam, a recreated church, and the Jean Hasbrouck house. Photos show the wigwam, the stone church with graveyard, the Hasbrouck house, and the DuBois House marker.

1378801.abstract: Jamie logs day four of a Vermont road trip in New Paltz, describing a pastry stop at Saunderskill Farms, biking the Wallkill Valley Rail Trail, lunch at Lola's, a tour of Historic Huguenot Street, ice cream at Sleeping Giant in Kerhonkson, and a final night at Modern Accord Depot.

1379421.abstract: Jamie logs day five of a Vermont road trip: breakfast at Bread Alone Bakery, a hike in Overlook Mountain Wild Forest, a visit to Karma Triyana Dharmachakra Monastery, lunch at Shindig in Woodstock, sailing on the Hudson River near Kingston, dinner at Nic's Trattoria, and an evening arrival at Vermont Schoolhouse Farm Cottage in Shaftsbury.

1380440.abstract: Jamie describes stopping at Kaleidoscope Cafe on a drive to Saratoga, where owner Bruce serves homemade BBQ and ice cream. Jamie recommends the brisket, pulled pork, mac-n-cheese, Peanut Butter Infusion, and Sweet Blue-Nilla ice cream.

1380447.abstract: Jamie describes a family visit to the historic Saratoga Race Course, comparing it to the smaller Canterbury Park. Jamie recounts learning to place bets alongside Tammy, Tyler, and Mazie across Races 5-7, including a costly misunderstanding of an "Across the Board" bet that multiplied rather than divided the wager, though the family had two…

1380452.abstract: Jamie logs day six of a Vermont road trip, describing a farm breakfast near Studio Hill, lunch at Kaleidoscope Cafe in Saratoga Springs with owner Bruce, betting on races at the Saratoga Springs track, and a Walloomsac evening with dinner at Browns Brewing, a battlefield memorial, and a movie at Hathaway's Drive-in.

1380702.abstract: Jamie logs a day in Manchester, Vermont, covering coffee at Charlie's Coffee House, breakfast at Little Rooster, the Bromley Mountain Alpine Slide, a hike on the Appalachian Trail, shopping at Northshire Bookstore and Orvis, a visit to Hildene, pinball at Pastime Pinball, and pizza at Sam's Wood Fired Pizza.

1380868.abstract: Jamie describes trying the Alpine Slide at Bromley Mountain with Tammy, Mazie and Tyler, admitting anxiety beforehand since the ride looked like a fast luge track. Jamie finds it turns out to be simple fun, with a long, turn-filled slide and a scenic chairlift ride up.

1381127.abstract: Jamie logs day 8 of a Vermont road trip, following friend Ellen's suggestions: breakfast at Skinny Pancakes, shopping in Woodstock, Marsh-Billings-Rockefeller National Historical Park, Simon Pearce Gallery, King Arthur Flour, Bread & Puppet Theatre, and a rainy night at a Treehouse Airbnb in Glover with an AT&T hotspot problem.

1381236.abstract: Jamie discusses staying primarily in Airbnb properties and notices connected smart home devices like cameras and sensors appearing more often in rentals. Jamie proposes owners disclose device type, manufacturer, model, location, and who has remote access, arguing this would reassure guests while preserving benefits owners get from such devices.

1381387.abstract: Jamie logs day nine of a Vermont road trip, covering Montpelier stops at Three Penny Taproom, the Vermont State House, Greatest Caper escape room, and Rabble-Rouser, then St.

1381394.abstract: Jamie describes hiking a mile of the Appalachian Trail near Bromley Mountain, an interest sparked by reading Bill Bryson's "A Walk in the Woods," and shares photos of the trailhead, a footbridge over Bromley Brook, white trail blazes, and a boardwalk section.

1381395.abstract: Jamie describes a visit to Pastime Pinball, an arcade with a well-maintained collection of pinball machines spanning many eras, including the Cyclone machine remembered from youth and a favorite, the Metallica Pro.

1381396.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a visit to Hildene, the Vermont summer home of Robert Todd Lincoln, Abraham Lincoln's only child to reach adulthood. Images show the Georgian Revival mansion's front and rear facades, formal gardens, and dining room.

1381398.abstract: Jamie shares notes from a Pantera Blockchain call, highlighting companies including Alchemy, Offchain Labs, Veem, Bakkt, Bitso and Staked, plus points on NFT investment, market share shifts away from Bitcoin and Ethereum, and Bitcoin price speculation.

1381407.abstract: During a Vermont trip, Tammy discovers Dog Mountain near St. Johnsbury, a 150-acre spot created by Stephen Huneck and wife Gwen for people and dogs. Jamie describes visiting the memorial Chapel, where Mazie leaves a note honoring the family's dog Chase, who died in 2018.

1381409.abstract: Jamie visits the Fairbanks Museum & Planetarium in St. Johnsbury, VT, noting it has operated since 1889 and largely preserves its original century-old display style with only minor modifications. Jamie also attends two planetarium sessions and shares photos of taxidermy, a Regina music box, and the Victorian-era interior.

1381695.abstract: Jamie describes visiting Bread and Puppet Theater in Glover, VT, on a recommendation from friend Ellen, and shares photos of the outdoor performance including a flag routine, a turkey skit, and a giant puppet from the Domestic Resurrection Circus.

1382032.abstract: Jamie describes a 2.3-mile hike through Flume Gorge in New Hampshire during a day trip from St. Johnsbury, noting COVID-19 ticketed timed entries and long queues. Photos show the gorge's granite formations, wooden walkways and stairs, waterfalls, a covered bridge over the Pemigewasset River, and family moments with Tammy and Mazie.

1382045.abstract: Jamie logs day 10 of the Vermont road trip: hiking Flume Gorge, eating pancakes at Polly's Pancake Parlor in New Hampshire, exploring downtown Littleton, an encounter with baby leeches in the Ammonoosuc River, and dinner at Schilling Beer Co.

1382721.abstract: Jamie logs day 11 of a Vermont road trip, leaving Vermont for Rochester, NY, with stops at Dunkin' Donuts and DomAdi's Deli in Amsterdam, before settling into an Airbnb and eating dinner at Vern's.

1383408.abstract: Jamie describes a 90-minute cruise on the Sam Patch tour boat on the Erie Canal, including passing through Lock 32 and viewing a stretch where the canal sits 70 feet above nearby houses.

1383411.abstract: Jamie describes returning to Good Luck restaurant in Rochester to share the Good Luck Burger, a 1 lb. house-ground grass-fed beef burger with Cuba cheddar and vegetable slaw, split four ways. The visit comes three years and one day after a first trip there in 2018, and Jamie links to a video showing how to make the burger.

1383412.abstract: Jamie logs day 12 of a Vermont road trip in hot 89°F weather, including breakfast at Mad Hatter, a visit to the Rochester Museum & Science Center, coffee at Ugly Duck Coffee, shopping at Millennium Games, ice cream at Pittsford Farms Dairy, a boat tour on the Erie Canal aboard the Sam Patch, and dinner at Good Luck Burger before prepping for an…

1385104.abstract: Jamie describes riding a pink electric Donut Boat rented from Retro Boat Rentals in Saugatuck, cruising the Kalamazoo River and Kalamazoo Lake with Tammy and others, then stopping at a sand beach before returning the boat.

1385108.abstract: Jamie describes staying at the Floathaus of Saugatuck, a nordic-designed houseboat, as the final stop on a Vermont 2021 trip, sharing photos of its dock-side entrance, bright loft interior, and views from Tower Marina.

1385109.abstract: Jamie logs day 13 of a road trip, driving from Rochester through Pennsylvania and Ohio, encountering heavy thunderstorms near Cleveland, into Saugatuck, Michigan, where a rented Donut Boat, an ice cream stop at Charlie's Round the Corner, and a stay at the Floathaus of Saugatuck follow a power-outage-disrupted dinner plan.

1385709.abstract: Jamie recounts a Saugatuck Dune Rides trip with driver "Frosty," including a family photo atop the dune, and links back to previous dune ride visits from 2017 and 2013, joking about returning in 2025.

1385712.abstract: Jamie recounts day 14 of a Vermont road trip, spent in Saugatuck, Michigan: breakfast and dinner at Pennyroyal Cafe, shopping downtown at spots like Urban Found and Roan & Black, dune rides, and time at Oval Beach.

1385719.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a Coldplay concert at US Bank Stadium, describing it as a first visit to the venue. The photos capture the light show, laser effects, a performance from a satellite stage, floating balloons, and confetti covering the floor after the show ends.

1385720.abstract: Jamie attends a Coldplay concert from floor left, row 35, and notes the redundant tech systems used in the show's setup. Photos show laser beams, glowing wristbands, balloons, confetti bursts, and a packed arena crowd.

1386153.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a pottery painting visit to Express Yourself Art Barn in Saugatuck with Tammy, Mazie, and Tyler. Jamie and Tammy paint rainbow mason jar lanterns, Mazie paints garden stakes, and Tyler paints a turtle bank, all shipped home afterward.

1386158.abstract: Jamie logs day 15 of the Vermont Road Trip, listing stops including breakfast at GROW Café + Bistro, shopping at Urban Found, pottery at Express Yourself Art Barn, ice cream at Blue Star Cafe, time at Oval Beach, and dinner at Salt of the Earth in Fennville.

1386564.abstract: Jamie logs the final day of a Vermont road trip, driving from Floathaus in Saugatuck, Michigan through Indiana, Illinois, and Wisconsin, with stops at Uncommon Coffee Roasters, Rocky Rococo pizza, and C&J Candy Shoppe before arriving home in Minnesota with a final odometer reading of 3,894 miles.

1386567.abstract: On the drive back from the Vermont Road Trip, each family member names a favorite ice cream stop: Mazie picks Key Lime Pie at Sleeping Giant, Tammy picks Mint Chocolate Chip at Kilwins, Tyler picks Sea Monster at Charlie's Around the Corner, and Jamie picks Peanut Butter Chunk at Greater's.

1386572.abstract: Modeled on Harper's Index, Jamie tallies statistics from the Vermont Road Trip: 3,777 miles driven, 20 towns visited, five museums, nine ice cream shops, 2,958 photos, and Tyler's ten cheeseburgers, with links to each day's entries.

1391474.abstract: Jamie logs a day trip through Grand Rapids and Hibbing, Minnesota, in cool, misty weather. Activities include the "Rock'n the 50s" Escape Room at Itasca Historical Society, lunch at Spartan Deli, shopping at Bender's Shoe & Sport, Bender's Gifts, MacRostie Art Center, and The Lake & Co Shop, and Barely Reality VR.

1391781.abstract: Jamie shares photos from the BreakAway Kids Triathlon, run by Cycle Health, where Mazie and cousin Nora compete. Jamie notes SPS Commerce sponsors the nonprofit event and mentions a 91-year-old triathlete wishing the kids good luck.

1391782.abstract: Jamie attends a Foo Fighters concert at Xcel Energy, praising opening act Royal Blood and noting the band's tribute to hometown legends Hüsker Dü. Jamie describes the nearly three-hour set as an amazing show, with photos of the crowd and stage lighting.

1404522.abstract: Jamie visits Gooseberry Falls and describes drought conditions leaving the Lower Falls completely dry, jokingly renaming it "Mini Gooseberry Falls." Jamie shares photos from the visit in an embedded collection.

1404524.abstract: Jamie logs a day trip along Minnesota's North Shore from Wild Pines Cabin, including donuts in Grand Marais, hiking Artist Point and Sugarloaf Cove, a stop at Palisade Head, and visiting Gooseberry Falls affected by drought, ending with pizza and a campfire.

1408363.abstract: Jamie shares photos from TeamSPS's 2021 Kubb tournament, taken by volunteer photographer Tim Van Cleave, and links to a fuller album, the SPS Tech Blog post, and past Kubb events dating back to a 2014 Kubb class.

1425715.abstract: Jamie recounts the first day of an MEA 2021 road trip, driving from Minnesota through Wisconsin into Illinois, arriving in Chicago for lunch at Lou Malnati's, an afternoon at the Shedd Aquarium, check-in at the Chicago Athletic Association hotel, and an evening magic show at the Magic Parlour.

1425983.abstract: Jamie shares photos from a trip to Chicago in 2021, greeting the city in the brief caption accompanying the embedded photo collection.

1426042.abstract: Jamie recounts day two of the MEA 2021 road trip, from Chicago to Louisville: coffee at Fairgrounds, breakfast at Wildberry, walking Millennium Park and "The Bean," pizza at Home Run Inn, a stop at Albanese Candy Factory, driving through Indianapolis and Columbus, Indiana, crossing into Kentucky, and checking into an Airbnb in Louisville.

1426533.abstract: Jamie visits Churchill Downs and takes the Superstars & Spires Tour, learning about the history of the race, the venue, and the horses. Jamie comes away wanting to attend the Kentucky Derby someday, and shares photos from the visit.

1426535.abstract: Jamie visits the Louisville Slugger Museum & Factory and shares photos, noting that a computer lathes a professional bat in 47 seconds and that many batters have custom specifications for their bats.

1426539.abstract: Jamie recounts a tour-filled day in Louisville: breakfast at Biscuit Belly, tours of Churchill Downs, the Louisville Slugger factory, and Copper & Kings distillery, then dinner at The Mayan Cafe, part of the MEA 2021 road trip collection.

1427179.abstract: Jamie recounts day 4 of the MEA 2021 road trip in Louisville, exploring the NuLu neighborhood with stops at Quills Coffee, Biscuit Belly, and a Rabbit Hole bourbon tour and tasting. Jamie also browses shops, buys macarons and cookies, dines at Emmy Squared, and watches the movie Secretariat.

1427751.abstract: Jamie logs day five of the MEA 2021 road trip, including checking out of the Holy Goat, breakfast at Con Huevos, Heine Brothers Coffee, the Ali Center, a tour and shopping at Hermitage Farm, dinner at barn8, then crossing into Indiana to reach an Airbnb in Indianapolis.

1428317.abstract: Jamie recaps day six of the MEA 2021 road trip, covering coffee at Coat Check Coffee, a sports-focused visit to the Children's Museum of Indianapolis, lunch at Cake Bake Shop, art at Newfields, first-time duckpin bowling, and Dune's opening night.

1428863.abstract: Jamie recounts a rainy day seven of the MEA 2021 road trip in Indianapolis, including breakfast at Milktooth, visits to the Indianapolis Motor Speedway Museum and Vonnegut Museum and Library, the Wooden's Legacy statue, checking into Bottleworks Hotel, dinner at Livery, billiards, and a puzzle room at Twisted Room Escapes.

1429246.abstract: Jamie recounts day 8 of the MEA 2021 road trip in Indianapolis, covering coffee at Blue Collar Coffee, shopping stops, duckpin bowling at Pins Mechanical, lunch at Punch Burger, cake from Cake Bake Shop, custom shoe design at Kicasso, dinner at Public Greens, and billiards at Bottleworks Hotel.

1429547.abstract: Jamie recounts the final leg of the MEA 2021 road trip, driving from Indianapolis back home to Minnesota, with stops for coffee at Blue Collar Coffee and pizza at Rocky Rococo's in Sun Prairie, crossing into Illinois, Wisconsin, and Minnesota, arriving home after a total of 1,577.4 miles.

1429604.abstract: During a final evening in Indianapolis, Jamie's family visits Kicasso, a shoe-painting experience, each creating custom designs on plain sneakers. Jamie paints shoes commemorating Weekly Thing issue 200, while Tammy, Mazie, and Tyler each choose different styles and colors.

1429606.abstract: Jamie describes a new custom Jiggy Thing Puzzle, titled Celebration City, created by Jamie's family for the upcoming Things 4 Good Fall Fundraiser, which otherwise features Things 4 Good Candles. Jamie notes satisfaction with how the custom box design turned out.

1433783.abstract: Jamie describes making a "Punk Rock Candle" from leftover wax scraps and wood wick trimmings normally discarded during candle-making, poured into a tinfoil vessel instead of a jar. The roughly 8-inch candle uses three 3/4-inch wood wicks and burns well.

1440607.abstract: Jamie describes the Things 4 Good Fall Fundraiser, where over 100 people bought Things 4 Good Candles, Jiggy Thing Puzzle #001 "Celebration City," Four Bees Honey (made by Tammy's sister Angie), and cookies baked by Tammy and the kids, raising $4,757 split among Constellation Fund, Free Bikes 4 Kidz, Appetite for Change, and Feed My Starving…

1441657.abstract: Jamie claims ENS governance tokens tied to the primary ENS name thingelstad.eth, becoming a voting member of the Ethereum Name Service DAO without delegating the tokens. Jamie cites a NiftyTable writeup calling ENS a key case study for decentralized ownership, comparing the shift to community governance of the early-1990s DNS system.

1441682.abstract: Jamie describes joining the Angry Bunny Club, an NFT project on Solana chosen for being fun, affordable, and not on Ethereum, purchasing six bunnies via the Magic Eden marketplace. Jamie explains the club's revenue-sharing mechanics, weekly airdrops, Discord community, and frames the purchase as a learning experience about NFTs.

1444201.abstract: Jamie describes ConstitutionDAO, a project formed to raise funds to bid on a privately owned copy of the US Constitution ahead of a Sotheby's auction. Jamie notes the fundraiser grew from $16M to $33.7M in ETH within twelve hours via Juicebox, and mentions sending a small ETH contribution to claim PEOPLE governance tokens.

1449011.abstract: Jamie describes touring the Faribault Woolen Mill, founded in 1865 and the only fully vertical woolen mill in the United States.

1449752.abstract: Jamie describes reading Oliver Burkeman's book Four Thousand Weeks: Time Management for Mortals and creates a visualization using Shortcuts and the Charty app, showing nested rings for the current week, weeks until the next birthday, and total weeks lived.

1452674.abstract: Jamie describes setting up a Donor Advised Fund called Things 4 Good on Endaoment, a DeFi community foundation, connecting a wallet, depositing 0.15 ETH (converted to USDC), and issuing a $100 grant to the Internet Archive. Jamie also deploys smart contracts for two additional 501(c)(3) organizations, Constellation Fund and Minnestar.

1455534.abstract: Jamie shares photos from the 2021 New Standards Holiday Show, describing it as a favorite holiday tradition after the previous year's hiatus. Photos show performers in festive costumes, colorful stage lighting, and a full band on an ornate theater stage.

1460177.abstract: Jamie describes registering three Solana Name Service (SNS) domains from Bonfida—thingelstad.sol, jamiethingelstad.sol, and weeklything.sol—through a 3-day auction process bid in FIDA tokens, acquired via Gate.io after other exchanges refused US citizens.

1460185.abstract: Jamie explores Namebase (HNS), a naming system that registers root-level names, after previously setting up ENS and SNS domains. Jamie discovers that thingelstad, jamiethingelstad, and weeklything have all already been purchased by others, at prices ranging from pennies to $30, and questions how these squatters identify names to buy.

1464208.abstract: Jamie describes visiting the Quantum Mirror exhibit by Adrian Stein at REM5VR with Tammy, involving a gallery VR experience to "upload yourself" followed by a mirrored room with looping video art. Jamie notes the digital art's NFT tie-ins and wishes a POAP token had marked the experience.

1469234.abstract: Jamie describes making a custom Christmas puzzle called "Land of Things" for Tammy, the hardest one yet at 18x24" and 500 pieces.

1469246.abstract: Jamie starts a Christmas LEGO project building the LEGO World Map (item 31203, 11,695 pieces), describing it as a giant pixel art build using 1x1 round tiles across forty 16x16 tiles totaling 10,240 pixels, and shares photos of sorted pieces and the first completed tile.

1473493.abstract: Jamie creates a custom 500-piece jigsaw puzzle from a collage of 18 Angry Bunny Club NFTs held in a personal wallet, designing it with no fixed orientation, and finishes solving it with family in about 90 minutes, calling it possibly the world's first Angry Bunny Club puzzle.

1473549.abstract: Jamie describes Famous Fox Federation's announcement letting users link an Ethereum address to a Solana Fox Profile, and details connecting thingelstad.sol via Phantom to thingelstad.eth via MetaMask, unifying Foxes, Angry Bunny Club, Divine, ENS domains, and a migrated POAP in one profile.

1473583.abstract: Jamie shares a video by photographer Layne Kennedy documenting life on a Central Minnesota family farm, including harvesting sweet corn for a local church, wildlife habitat conservation, Vikings game gatherings, and deer hunting traditions. Jamie calls the video wonderful and notes taking classes with Kennedy.

1475905.abstract: Jamie reports on making wood-wick tealight candles, following up on the previous day's 12oz candle batch, after learning to slow cooling by placing them on a towel. A burn test of four tealights shows a crackling sound, burn times of 5 hours or more, and good scent throw, leading Jamie to plan keeping tealights on hand to use leftover wax.

1476904.abstract: Jamie's wife Tammy surprises Jamie with a custom rock song for Jamie's 50th birthday, created by Songlorious and featuring the family, published on YouTube, Apple Music, and Spotify.

1485708.abstract: Jamie marks turning fifty by sharing a few reflections: generosity is never regretted, most things exist "in the middle" rather than as strict binaries, time cannot be controlled like money, choices are often "and" rather than "or," and Buddhism identified truths about attention and mindfulness long ago.

1504449.abstract: Jamie remembers Matthew Dornquast, met while Jamie worked at BigCharts and Dornquast served as CTO at Fallon, later founder of Code42 and CrashPlan.

1506271.abstract: Jamie describes signing up for Neeva's new Premium search offering after testing it for months, noting that early subscribers received a "New Beginning with Neeva" NFT, minted on Polygon and viewable on OpenSea, which Jamie calls a great idea and a keepsake for supporting private search.

1508065.abstract: Jamie links to Phantom Wallet's new iOS app, noting it includes an integrated browser and support for staking accounts, matching features of the Chrome plugin, and allows using Solana services on the go.

1509501.abstract: Jamie tries Quordle for the first time, a Wordle variant requiring players to solve four five-letter words simultaneously, and shares a results grid from Daily Quordle number 23 showing puzzles solved in 7, 4, 6, and 8 guesses. Jamie calls it a favorite Wordle variant.

1510896.abstract: Jamie and Jamie's wife Tammy attend Mike Birbiglia's newest show at the Pantages Theatre, describing it as a single story woven with tangents that mixes strong laughter with touching, heartfelt moments, and shares photos from the evening.

1510898.abstract: Jamie's child Tyler, a MrBeast fan, prompts a family introduction to the YouTuber for a birthday activity, starting with the CuriosityStream documentary "Beyond the Spotlight: MrBeast," followed by videos from MrBeast Reacts, MrBeast Gaming, and the main MrBeast channel.

1510936.abstract: Jamie and Jamie's wife Tammy attend Tina Schlieske's "Sinatra to Simone" show at The Dakota, marking a first return to the venue since the pandemic. Schlieske's sister Laura joins for several songs and duets, and photos show the performers on stage with balloons and a neon sign visible.

1515545.abstract: Jamie describes a day snowmobiling near Tower, Minnesota, starting at Lake Vermillion Houseboats before crossing Pike Bay for breakfast at Good Ol' Days Cafe. After buying hand warmers, the group rides a loop for over three hours, with mixed opinions on length and cold.

1516475.abstract: Jamie recounts returning to Wintergreen Dogsled Lodge near Ely, 13 years after a 2009 dogsledding trip with photographer Layne Kennedy, this time bringing the whole family for a half-day outing in temperatures around -4°F, and shares a photo collection from the trip.

1522266.abstract: Jamie describes attending Imagine Dragons' Mercury Tour at the Target Center with family, after daughter Mazie, a big fan of the band and Dan Reynolds, chose Jamie's family to join. The two-hour show felt like the most normal event attended since COVID, and photos show the stage, crowd, and a family selfie.

1522269.abstract: Jamie describes participating in the MnTech Tech Talent event alongside Caroline Karanja, who presents the new Tech Inclusion Alliance, followed by a panel with Tarek Tomes discussing efforts to bring diverse talent into tech.

1533385.abstract: Jamie shares Edina's 2022 Assessment Report, which shows the city's total Estimated Market Value rising from $13.76 billion in 2021 to $15.45 billion in 2022, a 12.4 percent increase that exceeds the combined growth of 2019-2021. Jamie questions whether such a jump reflects the market catching up, getting ahead, or inflation.

1533610.abstract: Jamie describes a Family Space Camp weekend that includes runs on the Multi Axis Trainer, a full Space Shuttle mission simulation with Tyler as EECOM, Mazie as PAYCOM, Tammy as CAPCOM, and Jamie as FDO doing the launch countdown, plus a planetarium show, an IMAX film on the ISS, lessons on NASA's Artemis program, and views of a Saturn V, Saturn…

1533615.abstract: Jamie visits the Ryman Auditorium in Nashville, describing it as the birthplace of country and bluegrass music. Jamie notes the venue was originally built as a tabernacle and finds walking through it, amid thoughts of its history of performances, nearly spiritual. Photos show the exterior and the wooden pew seating inside.

1533619.abstract: Jamie describes visiting The Escape Game in Nashville to play the Timeliner: Train Through Time room with another family, a dad and three boys. Jamie finds the room challenging but fair, noting the group used bonus buffer time to open the final door, making it room 41 on Jamie's escape room list.

1533852.abstract: Jamie compiles and maintains a running list of organizations supporting Ukraine during the invasion, categorized into donation funds, specialized causes, and cryptocurrency options. Notable entries include United24, the Ukrainian Red Cross, UNICEF, Razom for Ukraine, and Kyiv Independent, with brief descriptions of each group's mission.

1551304.abstract: Jamie discovers Cats Will Eat You, a Minnesota artist who has created and published original art daily for 15 years, and purchases the NFT "ring rang rung" from the collection. Jamie notes the artwork's communication metaphors, mentions viewing its creation process via Artivive, and shares that the piece was featured in the 2022 SXSW NFT Gallery.

1551310.abstract: Jamie mints 50 hand-drawn NFT copies of "Support Ukraine" on Nifty.Ink, a Gnosis blockchain platform, priced at $10 each, with Jamie matching each sale to contribute $20 per copy toward a $1,000 goal for direct crypto donations to Ukraine via thedigital.gov.ua.

1565708.abstract: Jamie lists Kentucky Derby day bets across several races, including Gun It, Doppelgänger, Bells the One, Kimini, Public Sector, and Kentucky Ghost, with the 148th Derby itself featuring wagers on Zandon, Cyberknife, Smile Happy, and Simplification.

1582615.abstract: Jamie completes the LEGO World Map (11,695 pieces), a set started right after Christmas 2021, and shares photos of the finished mosaic. Jamie notes the build suits jigsaw puzzle fans and required help from Tammy, the kids, and two cousins since building alone felt overwhelming.

1589138.abstract: Jamie republishes an introduction originally posted on the POAP Discourse server, describing discovery of POAPs through the ENS 4th Anniversary Snapshot Vote and creation of 12 POAP events, including ones for ConstitutionDAO, a 50th birthday, and the Weekly Thing newsletter's 200th issue.

1589222.abstract: Jamie describes winning the auction for Lil Noun 1416 and joining Lil Nouns DAO, a Decentralized Autonomous Organization connected to Nouns DAO. Jamie explains how the two projects share code, treasuries, and cross-holdings, and notes interest in DAOs as a model for organizing collective action.

1589223.abstract: Jamie creates a Proof of Attendance Protocol (POAP) token, "Magic Pines Summer of 2022," claimable in person at the Thingelstad family lake house between Memorial Day and Labor Day. Jamie commissions the artwork through Poapathon and also sets up magicpines.eth, suggesting it could become a family DAO.

1589227.abstract: Jamie recounts seeing Sigur Rós at the State Theatre in Minneapolis, having first discovered the band through the 2008 album Með suð í eyrum við spilum endalaust after a 2012 trip to Iceland, and previously seeing them live in 2013.

1589237.abstract: Jamie describes sending a copy of the "HELLO" Ink NFT, minted on Nifty.Ink for 0.10 DAI each, to every address holding a Weekly Thing POAP token, using CSVs from the Weekly Thing #200 and Five Year Anniversary event pages on Gnosis chain.

1589472.abstract: Jamie visits the Edina Art Fair with Mazie after its return from the pandemic, highlighting artists including H. Ward Miles, Andrew Carson (whose wind sculptures Jamie has owned for over 20 years), Brian Schmidt (from whom Mazie buys prints), Melissa Helene, Bradley Fritz, Linda Morvant, and Beeper Bébé.

159887.abstract: Jamie reflects on a Pinboard link from February 2007 marking the start of exploring Getting Things Done, noting over 10 years of continued practice and improvement, calling GTD one of Jamie's decade projects expected to keep providing value.

1606725.abstract: Jamie orders UniFi networking gear for a new home, choosing to stick with UniFi after positive experience with the current setup. The order includes a Dream Machine (router, firewall, CloudKey), WiFi 6 Long-Range Access Points for each floor, two Switch Lite 16 PoE units, and two Switch Flex Minis.

1608846.abstract: Jamie describes holding eight Noun Cats, calling the project a gateway into the wider Nouns ecosystem, and highlights Early Birbs, a community-created collection by Noun Cats Co-Founder Dean Harvey, available only to Noun Cat holders. Jamie mints Early Birbs #418-425 to match existing Noun Cats.

1608849.abstract: Jamie announces being named the Large Corporate ORBIE Winner by Twin Cities CIO, linking to the LinkedIn announcement and a related share from SPS Commerce, where Jamie works, along with a photo marking the honor.

161117.abstract: Jamie describes migrating 15 years of blog content through .Text, WordPress, Squarespace, and now Jekyll with Markdown files, preserving all content. Jamie notes fixing links and organizing media files is slow, requiring extensive manual work despite scripting, and turning out to be more involved than expected.

1618480.abstract: Jamie identifies three phrases—"only," "just," and "easy"—as words that presume something is simple without the speaker having the context to judge actual difficulty. Jamie links to a related Word List page.

1628794.abstract: Jamie recounts a weeklong photography trip to Iceland in September 2012 with three friends and describes long wanting to return with the whole family. Jamie announces departure from Minneapolis, landing in Iceland the next morning, alongside a map highlighting Reykjavik, Akureyri, the Blue Lagoon, and Skaftafellsjokull glacier.

1629435.abstract: Jamie logs repeated delays to Delta flight DL260 from Minneapolis, ultimately pushed from a 8:20p departure to 12:45p the next day due to a pilot shortage, ending with the family taking a taxi home to retry the Iceland trip later.

1629803.abstract: Jamie logs the first day of an Iceland trip, detailing a canceled DL260 flight rebooked to DL9900, a Lyft to the airport, thunderstorm delays, landing in Keflavik at 11:55p, picking up an Enterprise rental car, and checking into the Silica Hotel at 2:15a before sleeping as the sun rises.

1630136.abstract: Jamie logs day two of an Iceland trip, from the Blue Lagoon's Silica Hotel through Snæfellsnes Peninsula stops including Rauðfeldsgjá canyon, Arnarstapi, Snæfellsjökull National Park's basalt formations and black sand beach, and Kirkjufell Mountain, ending at Kirkjufell Guesthouse.

1630758.abstract: Jamie logs day three of an Iceland trip: coffee at Kaffi Grundarfjordur, a visit to the Glaumbær Turf House, driving to Akureyri, dinner at Strikið, and mineral baths at Forest Lagoon, with a map showing the 430 km route.

1631456.abstract: Jamie logs day four of an Iceland trip, traveling from Akureyri through Goðafoss waterfall to Húsavík, visiting the Húsavík Whale Museum, whale watching with North Sailing, dining at Naustið, then continuing to Fosshotel Mývatn.

1631992.abstract: Jamie logs day five of an Iceland trip, marking a 20th anniversary while traveling from Fosshotel Mývatn to Dettifoss, Selfoss, the Námafjall geothermal area, Hverfjall crater rim, and Dimmuborgir, ending with anniversary dinner at Vogafjós Farm-to-Table restaurant.

1633176.abstract: Jamie logs day 6 of an Iceland road trip, driving from Fosshotel Mývatn to Borgarfjörður Eystri, stopping at Rjúkandafoss, hiking to Stórurð, viewing puffins at Hafnarhólmi, and ending at Skarðás Country Cabins in Egilsstadir.

1633712.abstract: Jamie logs day 7 of an Iceland trip, traveling from Egilsstadir to Höfn along the Ring Road, with stops in Seyðisfjörður, Djúpivogur, and pastries at Fellabakarí, ending with pizza dinner and check-in at Fosshotel Vatnajökull.

1638915.abstract: Jamie logs day 8 of an Iceland trip, moving from Fosshotel Vatnajökull to Jökulsárlón glacial lagoon and Diamond Beach after a wind-delayed Zodiac tour, then checking into Foss Hotel Glacier Lagoon and hiking to Svartifoss Waterfall.

1638917.abstract: Jamie logs day nine of an Iceland trip: checking out Fosshotel Glacier Lagoon, a five-hour hike on Vatnajökull Glacier with Troll Expeditions, a stop at Fjaðrárgljúfur Canyon, dinner at Smiðjan Brugghús in Vík, and driving to The Garage, which Jamie calls amazing.

1639407.abstract: Jamie logs day 10 of an Iceland trip: visiting Skogafoss waterfall, hiking half of the Waterfall Way to Cascading Falls, touring Skogar Museum's turf houses, walking to Kvernufoss, eating pizza in Vik, and attending the Icelandic Lava Show.

1639916.abstract: Jamie recounts a Super Jeep and ATV tour of Þórsmörk with Into the Wild, including Eyjafjallajökull, Stakkholtsgjá Canyon, Gljúfrafoss, and Seljalandsfoss, followed by a hot tub at The Garage, dinner at Black Crust Pizzeria, Reynisfjara Black Sand Beach, and a visit to Steinahellir Cave with Mazie.

1640616.abstract: Jamie logs day 12 of an Iceland trip: leaving The Garage, ferrying to the Westman Islands, visiting Eldheimar Museum and taking an ATV tour, then driving to Blue View Cabins. Jamie notes a knee injury from Day 9's glacier descent, prompting a change from Landmannalaugar to the Golden Circle for the next day.

1641069.abstract: Jamie logs day 13 of an Iceland trip, departing Blue View Cabin to explore Gullfoss, Geysir in Haukadalur Valley, and Þingvellir National Park, including Öxarárfoss, Langistígur, and Lögberg, plus dinner at Restaurant Mika.

1641608.abstract: Jamie recounts traveling from Blue View Cabin to Reykjavik, with breakfast and dessert at Sandholt, shopping on Laugavegur, visiting the Icelandic Punk Rock museum and Hallgrímskirkja Church, and attending "Icelandic Sagas: The Greatest Hits" at Harpa.

1642015.abstract: Jamie recounts the final full day of the Iceland 2022 trip in Reykjavik, covering breakfast at Sandholt, an escape room, the Pride Parade, the Sun Voyager, Fly Over Iceland, shopping stops including Rammagerðin and Kronan, and a final dinner at Íslenski Barinn.

1642295.abstract: Jamie logs the final day of the Iceland trip: departing Reykjavik, returning the Mazda CX-5 rental to Enterprise, flying DL261 to Minneapolis, and arriving home by 11:49a, with a map showing the route to Keflavik Airport.

1655574.abstract: Jamie describes the Noun Cats project, an early gateway into the Nouns ecosystem using CC0 licensing, and recounts minting 8 Invisibles plus a related Early Birbs set. Jamie later mints matching Noun Cats directly via Etherscan's contract interface after the project didn't sell out.

1659790.abstract: Jamie highlights Vitalik Buterin's upcoming book, "Proof of Stake: The Making of Ethereum and the Philosophy of Blockchains," with proceeds benefiting Gitcoin Grants.

1666916.abstract: Jamie recounts the 4th annual TeamSPS Kubb Tournament, featuring 16 teams competing in round-robin groups followed by bracket play, with Rubiks Kubb winning the overall #LeadTheWay bracket despite an unexpected sprinkler interruption. Jamie shares photos of teams playing and the handwritten tournament brackets.

1666919.abstract: Jamie and Jamie's wife Tammy travel to see Brandi Carlile perform at Red Rocks Amphitheatre, having vowed to attend any show within 100 miles after discovering the performer years earlier.

1666920.abstract: Jamie and Tammy rent Pedego Element Fat Tire electric bikes, first seen at the Minnesota State Fair, and ride Denver's Cherry Creek Trail to the city limit and back, just over 20 miles.

1666922.abstract: Jamie describes a visit with wife Tammy to Meow Wolf, an immersive art experience whose mission is creating interactive realms of story and exploration. Jamie finds it incredible, notes an overarching connecting story, and recommends visiting locations in Denver, Santa Fe, or Las Vegas.

1667602.abstract: Jamie links to Roadmap by Dariush (0xDariush.eth), a project documenting a hitchhiking journey from Armenia through Georgia and Turkey to Europe, shared on Ethereum. Jamie notes support via Nouns DAO proposal 862 and purchases one of the OG 100 tokens, finding the experiment interesting.

1670471.abstract: Jamie attends Minnedemo 37 at the Riverview Theater, part of Twin Cities Startup Week, and describes seven presenting companies: Sunsett.io, Teqnizan Bluetooth Earrings, Collab Spot, IntelligentRx, Seraph7 Studios (which canceled), Aurelius 3.0, and SitEat.

1680911.abstract: Jamie attends MN Blockchain's State of Blockchain event at Fueled Collective in Minneapolis, meeting artists like Cats Will Eat You and hearing panels on Filecoin, StorJ, UMN Blockchain club, and NFT-based campaign fundraising. Jamie notes the event's diversity but wishes for more technologists, and describes distributing event POAPs.

1693531.abstract: Jamie logs day zero of a Disney World trip, noting hot weather, 10,659 steps, a flight landing, a ride to the hotel with Reginald, and check-in at Pop Century, with links to other days' logs.

1693532.abstract: Jamie logs a Disney World day at Epcot and Hollywood Studios, covering rides like Ratatouille, Guardians of the Galaxy and Frozen, meals across country pavilions, meeting up with family, and exploring Galaxy's Edge at night, totaling 19,381 steps.

1693533.abstract: Jamie logs day two of a Disney World trip at Animal Kingdom, recording warm weather and 17,354 steps while visiting the Safari Ride, Rafiki's Island, Expedition Everest, a bird show and the Lion King show, plus meals, shopping and an evening swim at Pop Century.

1693535.abstract: Jamie logs day three of a Disney World trip at Epcot, listing rides like Frozen, Soarin', and Spaceship Earth, meals at Via Napoli and the Polynesian, and 20,758 steps despite afternoon rain.

1693537.abstract: Jamie logs day four of a Disney World trip, covering 20,148 steps through Hollywood Studios, the Beach Club, and Magic Kingdom, with rides like Small World, Thunder Mountain, and Pirates of the Caribbean, dinner at Frontera, and Cirque du Soleil at Disney Springs.

1693538.abstract: Jamie logs day five of a Disney World trip: sending family to the airport, checking out of Pop Century, exploring Caribbean Beach resort via Skyliner, and boarding the Galactic Starcruiser for Star Wars shopping and Halcyon missions.

1693539.abstract: Jamie logs day six of a Disney World trip, continuing the Halcyon experience with a shuttle to Batuu, missions, rides on Millennium Falcon and Rise of the Resistance, a droid workshop, drinks at Oma's, and concluding the Halcyon mission.

1693541.abstract: Jamie logs day 7 of a Disney World trip, moving from the Galactic Cruiser to a Sapphire hotel and taking a water taxi to Universal Studios. Highlights include riding the Hogwarts Express, Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey, Tyler getting chosen at Ollivanders, Jurassic Park's playground, Tower of Terror, and Dr.

1693542.abstract: Jamie logs day 8 of a Disney World trip, taking a boat to Universal Studios and covering 14,974 steps in the best weather so far. Activities include rides on Race Through New York, ET, Simpsons, and Minions, exploring Diagon Alley, an animal show, and lunch at Today Cafe.

1693543.abstract: Jamie logs day nine of a Disney World trip, recording 29,580 steps as the day's high, checking out of Sapphire Falls, moving to the Polynesian, and spending the day between EPCOT and Magic Kingdom riding Test Track, Splash Mountain, Space Mountain, and dining at Via Napoli and Teppan Edo.

1693544.abstract: Jamie logs the final day of a Disney World trip: Tammy and the kids hit Magic Kingdom for rope drop, riding Space Mountain, Little Mermaid, Big Thunder Mountain, and Splash Mountain before lunch at Be Our Guest, then flying home from MCO to MSP on Delta flight DL1143.

1696130.abstract: Jamie responds to a Twitter question from Cats Will Eat You asking how to validate someone owns a wallet address, recommending MyCrypto's Sign Message tool to create a signed message and the Verify Message tool to confirm the wallet's authenticity.

1704292.abstract: Jamie sets up a Reddit Vault, an Ethereum wallet Reddit created for testing crypto features, and retrieves its seed phrase.

1707136.abstract: Jamie records votes cast in Lil Nouns DAO governance: in favor of The Lil Nouns Show and Federation proposals, and against the Nouns x MrBeast proposal, citing dislike of its bounty incentive despite liking the Nouns/MrBeast concept.

1716226.abstract: Jamie describes minting the 12th "lapse" NFT from the Mainnet Merge Paint Party POAP canvas, an animated zoom showing pixels spelling "Thing" that Jamie placed and defended overnight. Jamie also notes owning the Mainnet Merge POAP.art Canvas Pixel Placer POAP token and mentions defending pixels near Hector's "HF" mark.
